import math
import unittest

from solution import encode_records


class EncodeRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_compact_json_preserves_top_level_and_nested_order(self):
        records = [
            {"z": 1, "a": {"third": 3, "first": 1}, "m": [{"b": 2, "a": 1}]},
            {"later": True, "earlier": None},
        ]
        expected = '[{"z":1,"a":{"third":3,"first":1},"m":[{"b":2,"a":1}]},{"later":true,"earlier":null}]'
        self.assertEqual(encode_records(records), expected)

    def test_empty_and_standard_json_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(encode_records([]), "[]")
        records = [{"string": "x", "integer": 2, "float": 1.5, "false": False, "null": None, "array": []}]
        self.assertEqual(
            encode_records(records),
            '[{"string":"x","integer":2,"float":1.5,"false":false,"null":null,"array":[]}]',
        )

    def test_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        records = [{"b": {"y": [2, 1]}, "a": 0}]
        snapshot = [{"b": {"y": [2, 1]}, "a": 0}]
        encode_records(records)
        self.assertEqual(records, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(list(records[0]), ["b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(list(records[0]["b"]), ["y"])

    def test_rejects_invalid_container_records_and_keys(self):
        for value in (None, (), {}, "[]", 1):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    encode_records(value)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_records([{"ok": 1}, []])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_records([{1: "bad"}])

    def test_non_json_and_non_finite_values_raise_value_error(self):
        for value in ({1, 2}, object(), math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    encode_records([{"value": value}])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
